press_references.value: Infinitus Launches AI-First, Human-Backed Hub Solution to Replace Specialty Pharma's Legacy Call-Center Infrastructure

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched an AI-first, human-backed hub solution for specialty pharmaceutical patient support. The platform combines AI agents for routine workflows with human experts for clinical, ambiguous, or judgment-intensive cases, aiming to reduce administrative costs and accelerate treatment access.

press_references.value: Infinitus Introduces Clinical Escalations, Bringing Real-Time Clinical Risk Detection to Healthcare AI Agent Conversations

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched Clinical Escalations, a real-time clinical risk detection system that monitors AI-powered healthcare conversations to identify and escalate emergent clinical events during routine administrative calls.

press_references.value: Infinitus Launches Studio, the First Healthcare-Specific No-Code AI Agent Builder

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched Infinitus Studio, a no-code, healthcare-specific AI agent builder platform that lets payors and pharmaceutical companies design, test, and deploy AI agents using natural language interfaces.

press_references.value: Infinitus Launches Agentic AI Suite for Health Plan Member Services

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched its Agentic AI Member Services Suite, a new platform that automates and personalizes inbound and outbound calls for health plan members to improve engagement and reduce administrative costs.

press_references.value: Infinitus Launches Next-Generation Clinical AI Agents

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched its next-generation clinical AI agents for patient-facing conversations, enabling healthcare organizations to use intelligent, empathetic and clinically aware voice agents for education, care management, risk assessments and other communications, including support for Spanish language calls.

press_references.value: Infinitus Launches Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server to Bring Standardized AI Interoperability to Healthcare

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to enable standardized AI interoperability in healthcare, allowing AI agents to connect with existing APIs and workflows for benefit verification, prior authorization, and appeals.

press_references.value: Infinitus Launches First Trusted Voice AI Agents for Healthcare

product_launches.description: Infinitus Systems launched the first trusted voice AI agents for healthcare, providing secure, accurate, and compliant conversational AI for patients, providers, and payors.

overview_description.description: Infinitus Systems is an AI healthcare company that automates phone calls. By automating tedious and time-consuming phone-based processes across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re improving therapy access, adherence, and affordability for patients. Healthcare is one of the biggest contributors to the US GDP and we are on a mission to reduce the complexity and spend on back-office administration. Infinitus has raised $51.4M to date and is backed by leading growth investors Kleiner Perkins, Coatue, and Google Ventures. Learn more by visiting infinitus.ai or contact us to get started.

about_short_description.short_description: AI healthcare company focused on automating complex phone-based workflows

product.name: Infinitus Voice AI Platform
product.description: A healthcare communication platform that automates clinical and administrative conversations with patients, payors, and providers across phone and other channels.

product.name: Infinitus AI Agents
product.description: Voice AI agents that conduct healthcare calls with patients, payors, and providers, completing workflows such as benefit verification, prior authorization follow-up, outreach, and adherence support.

product.name: Infinitus AI Copilots
product.description: AI copilots that assist healthcare staff with complex phone-based workflows by reducing IVR navigation and hold-time work while supporting data collection and follow-up tasks.

product.name: Infinitus Studio
product.description: A no-code builder for healthcare teams to design, test, deploy, and refine AI agents using workflow controls, healthcare protocols, and operational guardrails.

product.name: Infinitus Lens
product.description: A conversation analysis product that evaluates patient, provider, payor, human, and AI interactions to identify risks, trends, and information requiring follow-up.

product.name: Healthcare Benefit Verification Services
product.description: Automated benefit verification services that contact payors and pharmacy benefit managers to confirm coverage, eligibility, requirements, and patient cost information.
